description: WarehousePG cluster: one coordinator and a number of segment hosts. No mirrors and no standby coordinator are offered: a failed segment stops the cluster, which is what a benchmark wants to see.

fields.description: auto = settings sized from the machine, role, topology and workload (every value the run used is in its configs); stock = the engine's own defaults. A key set in the config wins over auto.
fields.name: tuning
fields.title: Tuning

fields.description: Server release; the image is pulled per release. The PostgreSQL base of the release decides the spelling of the coordinator in gpinitsystem (MASTER_* up to 9.4, COORDINATOR_* from 12).
fields.name: version
fields.title: WarehousePG version

fields.description: Machines that carry the primary segments; the coordinator is one more machine.
fields.name: segment_hosts
fields.title: Segment hosts

fields.description: Primary segments on each segment host. 0 = auto: half of the host's vCPUs, at least 1 (what Arenadata ADB defaults to).
fields.name: segments_per_host
fields.title: Segments per host

fields.description: Which planner the cluster uses: GPORCA (the optimizer GUC on) or the PostgreSQL-based planner (off). Set cluster-wide; every release ships with GPORCA built in.
fields.name: optimizer
fields.title: Query optimizer
